title: GNSS: add dissectors for the u-blox UBX protocol
description:
Add dissectors for the UBX protocol as used by u-blox GNSS receivers.
Includes dissectors for UBX-NAV-DOP, UBX-NAV-EOE, UBX-NAV-POSECEF,
UBX-NAV-PVT, UBX-NAV-SAT, UBX-NAV-TIMEGPS, UBX-NAV-VELECEF, and
UBX-RXM-SFRBX messages.

1. How is this dissector ever going to be called? There's no handoff from another dissector, e.g. some well known UDP port. Is this only for use with 'Decode As...'?
2. It would be nice to generalize the checksum code as well into fletcher-tvb.c or something. This could replace checksum_acp142 in packet-p_mul.c. But that could be done another day.

For the moment, only "Decode As" (or using user DLT) would be used to call the dissector. I am working on an extcap plugin for the protocol. I will add a handoff logic when the extcap plugin and a dedicated DLT is accepted.

Hello,
Sorry, I wasn't able to find how I can use the dissector with "Decode as" on the data field in TCP frames. Is this supported ? Or it requires to be encapsulated in another specific protocol ?

Thanks in advance

I suggest to use the extcap plugin ("ubxdump.py") for directly getting the UBX messages from the receiver. (I never tried to decode UBX messages inside a TCP stream.) For the moment, there is no dedicated DLT for UBX, so the extcap plugin uses the DLT_USER 147. You can configure the "ubx" dissector Under Settings -> Protocols -> DLT_USER accordingly.
don't also forget to add dissector to docbook/release-note...

commits_data.message:
GNSS: add dissector for the u-blox UBX protocol

Add dissector for the UBX protocol as used by u-blox GNSS receivers.
Includes dissectors for UBX-NAV-DOP, UBX-NAV-EOE, UBX-NAV-POSECEF,
UBX-NAV-PVT, UBX-NAV-SAT, UBX-NAV-TIMEGPS, UBX-NAV-VELECEF, and
UBX-RXM-SFRBX messages.
